Pool Summary

One row per deal series, reflecting that series' most recent reporting period in our deduped ABS-EE data.

Issuer Series Vintage Age (mo) Active leases Pool balance WA RV % ALG % RV exposed Mat. 12m Terminations Returned CRR CRR (3m) Realized G / L Top-3 models

CRR = Cumulative Residual Realization Rate = realized residual ÷ scheduled residual on returned vehicles only. Industry-standard metric (S&P / Moody's / Fitch / KBRA / DBRS converge here). >100% = pool recovered above booked residuals; <100% = realized RV loss. Age + RV exposed are seasoning context — early-life CRR readings are volatile and not directly comparable to fully-seasoned ones. CRR (3m) isolates the most recent market window. Mat. 12m = lease-maturity concentration (Fitch criterion: clusters of upcoming maturities concentrate exposure to whatever the used-car market does in those months). Realized G/L = realized − scheduled in dollars. "—" means data not reported by the issuer.

Cumulative Residual Realization Rate (CRR) — Time Series

CRR per series over calendar time. Industry-standard primary RV-performance metric (S&P / Moody's / Fitch / KBRA / DBRS converge here). Dashed line at 100% = breakeven.

Only terminated leases with both liquidationProceedsAmount and baseResidualValue populated contribute to CRR. Issuers that zero out the proceeds field (e.g., BMWLT) cannot appear here.

CRR — Vintage Curves

CRR per series plotted by months-since-first-reporting. Directly comparable across vintages — answers "how is the 2024-A pool tracking at month 12 vs. how 2023-A was at month 12?" Cohort comparison is standard agency practice (per Fitch's auto-lease ABS criteria).

Disposition Mix Over Time

Monthly share of terminated leases by termination-indicator code, faceted per series. A rising purchase share (common in strong used-car markets) signals lessees are exercising buyouts instead of returning vehicles.

SEC ABS-EE termination codes (corroborated against Ford 10-D Lease Terminations table): 1 = Retained (lessee purchased), 2 = Returned (auctioned), 3 = Charged-off / repossessed, 4 = Other, 98 = Removed by servicer. Returned vehicles drive RV performance — see chart above.

Delinquency Tracking — Time Series

60+ DPD rate per issuer over calendar time, aggregated across all active series within each issuer.

Delinquency — Vintage Curves

60+ DPD rate per deal series plotted against months-since-first-reporting-period. Lets you compare how deals at the same seasoning are performing across vintages.

Cumulative Net Loss — Time Series

Cumulative charge-off rate (sum of chargedOffAmount ÷ original pool balance) over calendar time, aggregated across series within each issuer.

v1 tracks charge-offs only; recovery data via liquidationProceedsAmount is tied to terminations (not just defaults) and is not currently netted from CNL.

Cumulative Net Loss — Vintage Curves

CNL rate per deal series plotted against months-since-first-reporting-period. Directly comparable across issuers and vintages.
